# Noto Sans SC font notice

The desktop application embeds Noto Sans SC to render Simplified Chinese text
reliably on Windows installations that do not have a suitable system fallback.

Source: [notofonts/noto-cjk](https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk),
`Sans/Variable/TTF/Subset/NotoSansSC-VF.ttf`.

Noto fonts are licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1.
